mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dermaseptin-PH directly permeabilized tested bacterial and yeast cell membranes in a SYTOX Green membrane-permeability assay; effect sizes are source-located to the text/figure, not generalized beyond the tested organisms.
direct_assay_types: SYTOX Green bacterial/yeast membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports membrane permeabilization in the tested strains; it does not prove a single universal pore/carpet model for every organism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Dermaseptin-PH caused rapid membrane permeability signal in MCF-7 cells in a SYTOX Green assay after peptide addition.
